Arcanist.special: Known for the discovery or recovery of a valuable or interesting magical item, spell, ritual or lost lore spoken of in legend.

Archer.special: Have a high quality or magical missile weapon.

Battlemancer.special: Must have made 1 magical weapon both imbued personally and mastered with Weapon Lore. Must have 1 armor set both imbued personally and mastered with Armor Lore.

Beguiler.special: Have permanent control of at least 3 beings.

Cajoler.special: Must have had at least one enemy killed or imprisoned without taking any direct action. Must have another be blamed and take the punishment for a crime the cajoler did or made to happen. Must be free from criminal bounty or warrant in the community in which they live and any neighboring communities. Must have at least one patsy, readily available.

Cavalier.special: Must have a steed either in superb condition or magical.

Delver.special: Have a special collection of some type of items that is the greatest in the world.

Dreamer.special: Must have created a dream animal and developed their own dream magic item.

Explorer.special: Known to have discovered a new land, a new type of valuable or interesting item, or a new species of flora or fauna.

Heretic.special: Must have converted 10 followers and one other clergy to a new belief system.

Hunter.special: Has slain or captured an Animal, Magical Animal, and Magical Creature of legend.

Jester.special: Must have influenced an important leader to take an action opposite of what they originally planned.

Missionary.special: Known for converting more than 50% of a particular group.

Plunderer.special: Has retrieved at least 3 treasure troves worth over 5000 gp, with at least 1 treasure magical or divinely protected enough to cause death to the unwary.

Runesmith.special: Have 1 item with at least 4 permanent runes.

Sorcerer.special: Must have the knowledge of and have summoned at least 5 supernatural beings.

Summoner.special: Must have the knowledge of and have summoned at least 5 supernatural beings.

Wilder.special: Have 1 spell or effect they are well known for.
